description.en: Prompting-MammAlps is a camera-trap text-to-video retrieval benchmark, evaluating video-language models on fine-grained retrieval of ecological events. It includes a test set of 135 queries and 775 candidate videos, with a proposed method that combines action localization with LLM-based parsing.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Text-to-video retrieval in ecological domains requires spatiotemporal understanding that current VLMs lack. This benchmark provides a standardized evaluation for fine-grained and interpretable retrieval, highlighting the limitations of zero-shot VLMs.
